title: The Bridge of Names
text: A bridge built of planks, each one carved with a name, thousands of names, worn smooth by passing feet. Some of the names are your ancestors'. The bridge holds only those who give one of their own to it, and the gaps between the planks are very dark.

options.label: Each Scion decides whether to carve their own name into a plank, and give it to the bridge.

outcomes.text: Their name joins the others, and something of them stays behind with it, and something of the others comes with them.

options.label: Each Scion decides whether to cross on a dead stranger's name, and hope the bridge does not notice.

outcomes.text: Nobody notices the lie. The dead name holds, though it does not like it.
The plank under them notices, and gives way, and the dark between the planks is very deep.
